name: Permanent Marker | 14 Pack Infused Pre-Rolls
description:
HOMIEZ | 14 Pack Infused Pre-Rolls | Permanent Marker 
Why roll one when you can roll deep?
These infused pre-rolls are loaded with concentrates—inside the joint, on the outside, or both—bringing that extra fire every time you spark up. Smooth, potent, and made for those who like their joints leveled up.
HOMIEZ is all about good vibes without the high price tag. This mid-range flower is perfect for daily seshes, passing around with the homies, and keeping the energy right. With an off-the-hook strain selection, every pack hits a little different and keeps things feeling surreal.
14 pre-rolls. Big flavor. Bigger vibes. Roll up with the HOMIEZ! 
INDICA
Flavors
Ammonia
Chemical
Tobacco
